# P&L explain (`pnl-explain` v1)

Daily P&L attributed to risk factors, new trades and residual.

**Group:** Market risk · **Mnemonic:** `PNL` · **Identifiers:** `PNL-…` in `resultId`

Open one with `PNL <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: pnl-explain
version: 1
description: "Daily P&L attributed to risk factors, new trades and residual."
match: { kind: pnl-explain, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "Market risk · P&L explain", id: $.resultId }
strip:
  - { label: Date, bind: $.date, fmt: date }
  - { label: Actual, bind: $.actual, fmt: signed0, tone: sign, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Explained, bind: $.explained, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: Unexplained, bind: $.unexplained, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
panels:
  - id: attribution
    kind: hbar
    title: Attribution
    key: F2
    rows: $.attribution
    label: factor
    value: pnl
    fmt: signed0
    tone: sign
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.book, 'book')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
